decision_ref: Current Books Arranger 0.27.0 release chat, 2026-11-11 Asia/Jerusalem. Sergei answered Jane’s explicit request to run one more hidden test and publish if it passes. Exact sent timestamp unavailable.
decision_text: Jane asked verbatim: “Can I run the hidden test once more and publish `v0.27.0` if it passes? Windows may leave one additional 8-byte history reference after I remove the temporary tray entry.” Sergei replied verbatim: “Yes”. The earlier private scope persists for this one corrected candidate, up to 600000 ms. The canonical PA-1 uses a private catalog and deliberately attempts a synthetic invalid installer. It removes only its exact newly created own Windows tray leaf. Those are test mechanics, not additional user quotations. No foreground focus, real installation, live library, or tool write to shared UIOrderList. approved_at is the UTC preparation time, not a message timestamp.
